hero.title: Turn every satisfied customer into visible proof.
hero.subtitle: Waevon structures a simple, controlled exchange to improve your online reputation without pressuring your customers.

stats.goalText: Increase Google reviews with AI-powered responses

constat.paragraph1: We have observed that most businesses have satisfied customers, but online this reality is barely visible: few reviews are left, negative feedback takes up more space, and the final image does not reflect the daily work.

solution.title: Waevon turns satisfaction into visible proof.
solution.body: The customer performs a useful action for the business, then accesses a framed experience defined in advance. Nothing is imposed: everything is clear, transparent and under control.

steps.title: Create a campaign
body: The merchant creates a campaign from their Waevon account and chooses their goal, for example getting more Google reviews.

steps.title: Share the QR code at the point of sale
body: Waevon generates a QR code linked to the campaign.
It can be printed and placed on tables, at the counter or on an appropriate support.
A custom graphic support can also be designed to match the business image.

steps.title: Configure and track from the dashboard
body: From the dashboard, the merchant defines the rules of the experience: content, probabilities and parameters.
They then track their campaign progress in real time.

steps.title: Automate review management
body: When a customer leaves a review, Waevon can automatically respond thanks to artificial intelligence, with no manual action from the merchant.

points: With Waevon, the merchant always stays in control.
They precisely define what they want to achieve and what they are willing to offer.
Participation rules, probabilities and objectives are set in advance.
Each campaign runs within a clear framework, with no surprises or drift.
The merchant views all their campaigns and results from a single dashboard.

testimonials.name: Claire Martin
testimonials.quote:
Waevon made it much easier for us to collect reviews.
Satisfied customers naturally participate and also appreciate getting something in return.
It's a win for them and for us.

testimonials.name: Karim Benali
testimonials.quote:
Before, we struggled to get reviews.
With Waevon, customers play along to leave a review or follow us on social media.
It's simple to explain and well accepted.

testimonials.name: Sophie Laurent
testimonials.quote:
Customers are happy to take part in the experience after their visit.
On our side, it helps us improve our visibility without pressuring anyone.
Everything is easy to manage.

items.question: Does Waevon force customers to leave a review?
items.answer:
No.
The customer is free to participate or not.
Waevon offers an experience, never an obligation.

items.question: Do customers easily accept the concept?
items.answer:
Yes.
The exchange is clear and transparent.
Customers understand what they are doing and what they get in return.

items.question: Do I keep control over my campaigns?
items.answer:
Yes, completely.
The merchant defines the rules, parameters and objectives of each campaign from their dashboard.

items.question: Does it require daily time?
items.answer:
No.
Once the campaign is set up, everything is automated.
Tracking is done simply from the dashboard.

items.question: What happens with reviews left by customers?
items.answer:
Waevon can automatically manage responses to reviews thanks to artificial intelligence.
The merchant has nothing to do, unless they want to intervene.
